brief.aim: All seven columns are distinct measured geometric attributes of each kernel (area, perimeter, compactness, kernel length/width, asymmetry, groove length) and no outcome column is present, so the table is evidently assembled for unsupervised segmentation of kernels into natural groups; silhouette on these standardized features is the default workflow metric, with no grouping, chronology, or identifier structure in the schema.
brief.unit: One wheat kernel seed (single measured kernel of the seeds dataset)
